entities.summary: Alajärvi is a town and municipality of Finland. It is located in the South Ostrobothnia region. The town has a population of 8,981 and covers an area of 1,056.74 square kilometres (408.01 sq mi) of which 47.99 km2 (18.53 sq mi) is water. The population density is 8.9 inhabitants per square kilometre (23/sq mi). The town is unilingually Finnish.
